interface.signature: def findHeight(N: int, arr: list) -> int

preconditions.description: N is an integer between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.
arr is a list of length N.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, int) and -1 <= x <= 100000 for x in arr)
preconditions.description: Each element in arr is an integer between -1 and 10^5 inclusive.
Exactly one element in arr is -1, representing the root.

preconditions.expression: all(arr[i] == -1 or (0 <= arr[i] < N) for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: For every non-root node, its parent index is a valid node index within the array bounds.

postconditions.description: The return value is a non-negative integer.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max((lambda path: len(path) - 1)([i] + ([arr[j] for j in [i] if arr[j] != -1] + [arr[arr[j]] for j in [i] if arr[j] != -1 and arr[arr[j]] != -1] + ...)) for i in range(N))
postconditions.description: The return value equals the maximum depth of any node in the tree, where depth is the number of edges from the root to that node. This is computed by tracing the parent chain from each node to the root and counting the steps.
